question: Which customer segment had the most customers churn in 2025, and who was that segment's top customer by completed revenue in 2025? Give the customer's ID, name and 2025 completed revenue.

sql_attempts.sql: WITH segment_churn AS (SELECT c.segment, COUNT(c.customer_id) AS churned_count FROM customers AS c WHERE c.churn_date >= '2025-01-01' AND c.churn_date <= '2025-12-31' GROUP BY c.segment ORDER BY churned_count DESC LIMIT 1), top_customer AS (SELECT c.customer_id, c.customer_name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) AS rev FROM customers AS c JOIN orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN segment_churn AS sc ON c.segment = sc.segment WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date <= '2025-12-31' GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name ORDER BY rev DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT sc.segment, tc.customer_id, tc.customer_name, tc.rev FROM segment_churn AS sc CROSS JOIN top_customer AS tc
